nudge.pointer-only.evidence: The waker never types: it starts mail nudge, and the fleet types its own one pointer line. Against the fake, two sessions holding different mail were each rung with the same one line, no control character and no line of either body. Run against the fake only (test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-waker-wezfleet.ps1, 2026-10-13), which plays the contract in this waker's header; not yet run against the fleet's real command from a suite, which no suite may start.

state.box.evidence: mail state -To reads the session's pane for the box. Against the fake, an empty box read yes and a box holding text read no; for a session that is no candidate the pane is not read and the box is answered unknown, never yes. Run against the fake only (test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-waker-wezfleet.ps1, 2026-10-13), which plays the contract in this waker's header; not yet run against the fleet's real command from a suite, which no suite may start.

state.turn.evidence: mail state -To reads the session's pane for the turn. Against the fake, a resting session read no and one in a turn read yes. Run against the fake only (test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-waker-wezfleet.ps1, 2026-10-13), which plays the contract in this waker's header; not yet run against the fleet's real command from a suite, which no suite may start.

reach.unseen.evidence: mail nudge finds the pane and the terminal instance itself, from the fleet's own records, so it needs nothing this watcher saw since a restore. Against the fake, a session seated as not seen since a restore was rung once. Run against the fake only (test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-waker-wezfleet.ps1, 2026-10-13), which plays the contract in this waker's header; not yet run against the fleet's real command from a suite, which no suite may start.

nudge.guarded.evidence: mail nudge itself refuses a box that is not empty or a session that is not idle, at the moment it would type, and answers busy. Against the fake, a nudge sent straight at a session with text in its box, and at one mid-turn, typed nothing and answered busy, while a resting one was rung. Run against the fake only (test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-waker-wezfleet.ps1, 2026-10-13), which plays the contract in this waker's header; not yet run against the fleet's real command from a suite, which no suite may start.
